name: software_engineering_intern

categories.label: Core Technical Skills
categories.description: Proficiency in at least one modern language (Python, TypeScript, Java, C++, Go), Git version control, and data structures/algorithms fundamentals.

categories.label: Independent Projects
categories.description: Demonstrated initiative through self-built, non-trivial applications. Look for complexity, architecture, database usage, and original implementation over tutorial copies.

categories.label: Production & Practical Experience
categories.description: Prior software internships, research lab work, freelance delivery, or hackathon wins showing collaboration, code reviews, and testing.

categories.label: Open Source & GitHub Signals
categories.description: Public repositories, clear commit histories, documentation, code readability, or contributions to third-party open source projects.

bonus_criteria: Deployed application with active real-world users, notable open source maintainership (>50 GitHub stars), or published technical write-ups.
deductions_criteria: Resume includes buzzword stuffing without substance, dead links, or completely unverified claims.
